request: Open Opportunities on Crafting; clear searches after application restart except Planner; simplify Fish search to one field and fish names with game artwork.
baseline: Complete Open Emblems 20261030 source, including its staged content-sized item windows and shared map emblems. HEAD alone is not this candidate.
changes: Opportunities controller initialization chooses Crafting while retaining filters, mode, balances and all non-search settings. Existing startup-only clearing of Crafting, Exchanges and Best use searches remains. Tab round-trips retain the current section and query.

Fish Map replaces the native datalist with an accessible combobox/listbox: one name and the existing game-art icon per row, with no item ID, duplicate subtitle or tooltip. Place and item-ID search still use existing table filtering.

Only the outer search frame shows focus. Suggestions scroll within the available pane height, support arrows, Enter, Escape, Tab and pointer selection, and restart at the top for a new query. Images load lazily; absent art leaves no broken-image symbol.

Fish startup explicitly starts the map query empty. The immutable payload manifests and runtime pin were regenerated, without changing the compiled service, port contract, journal, profiles or reference data.

searchAudit.Opportunities: Startup clearing already existed for the three query/selection fields. Section initialization is the new change; startup does not rewrite settings just to clear a query.
searchAudit.Inventory and storage: InventorySessionController owns per-mode search and group-item query in memory. New sessions start empty; saved stock and storage imports are unchanged.
searchAudit.Recipe editor and Recipe Book: EditorModeSession and RecipeBookController searches, including workspace Recipe Book retention, are memory-only. Custom catalog searchKeywords are reference metadata, not disposable queries.
searchAudit.Resource Map, housing and worker plannin: Map search and target-search TextEditingControllers start empty. Back history is an in-memory list, not saved search state. Selected worker recipes, node networks, CP, housing, checklist and favorites remain saved.
searchAudit.Gathering: Field Guide, history and manual-loot query controls are initialized empty in widget state. Saved session records and calculator configuration are not cleared.
searchAudit.Fish: Map query and statistics-location filters are in-memory controls. Browser storage stores opacity, not queries. Session/profile API records are untouched. Shell HTML/CSS/JS already use no-store responses.
searchAudit.Planner exception: No Planner state or search lifecycle is changed. A synthetic disk round-trip verifies the saved Planner search and selected recipe remain.
